'''Goh's Frogadier''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのゲコガシラ''' ''Go's Gekogashira'') is the eleventh {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Kalos]] [[region]] and his one-hundred-and-eleventh overall.

==History==
==={{aniseries|JN}}===
[[File:Goh Grimer Froakie.png|thumb|left|250px|Froakie and Grimer]]
In ''[[JN103|The Future is Now, Thanks to Strategy!]]'', [[Goh]] encountered {{p|Frogadier}} as a {{p|Froakie}} in [[Lumiose City]]. It initially used its Frubbles to defend itself from capture, but with some advice from {{an|Bonnie}}, Goh was able to catch it. When Goh arrived at the [[Lumiose Gym]] with Bonnie, Goh introduced Froakie to {{Ash}} and {{an|Clemont}}.

In ''[[JN107|Big Brother to the Rescue!]]'', Froakie was shown to have befriended {{TP|Goh|Grimer}}, who had given its home cave for the newcomer to inhabit. Unfortunately, this also resulted in Grimer unintentionally polluting [[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]]'s water stream by bathing at the water source.

In ''[[JN108|Catching the Aura of Fate!]]'', Froakie was motivated to have a training match with [[Chloe's Eevee]] after seeing Ash's Pokémon train with each other. As a result of the match, Froakie [[Evolution|evolved]] into Frogadier.

In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', Frogadier attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.

==Personality and characteristics==
Frogadier is a very eager Pokémon and enjoys battling, as shown when it saw {{AP|Lucario}} and {{TP|Goh|Cinderace}} battling and wanted to do the same. As is usual of its species, Frogadier uses its Frubbles to defend itself. This made it difficult for [[Goh]] to capture Frogadier without {{an|Bonnie}}'s help.

At [[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]], Frogadier prefers to stay in dark places, like a cave, which is why [[Goh's Grimer]] had given up its home cave for it.

==Trivia==
* Frogadier, as a Froakie, was the last Pokémon belonging to one of [[Ash's friends]] to evolve onscreen.
* Frogadier is Goh's only [[first partner Pokémon]] that is mid-way through its evolutionary line.
* In the [[Pokémon in Brazil|Brazilian Portuguese]] dub, Frogadier is referred to as a female Pokémon.
* Frogadier is the fastest first partner Pokémon belonging to a main character to evolve in the {{pkmn|animated series}}, evolving in just five episodes after its [[JN103|debut]].
